basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old software engineer based in New Jersey. I graduated from Rowan University, and I'm an avid gamer with a particular passion for playing and modding Minecraft. I love sharing tips and tricks with the community and often help newcomers get started. When I'm not gaming, I enjoy shooting at the range and discussing the nuances of firearm policies. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends. Currently, I'm single and enjoy the flexibility it brings to my gaming schedule.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Rowan University. My knowledge in gaming and technology largely stems from my academic background, coupled with self-teaching and continuous learning through online platforms and communities. I also have a fair amount of knowledge about firearm policies and rights, which I actively discuss in relevant subreddits.
